versions.changelog: Balance and cost questions now answer from a live account read rather than from figures written into the package.

wealth-open-cal-set 0.1.1

- Introduced functionality to create a four-to-eight still wealth open calendar pack from user-supplied open windows, with each still representing a named fund open window.
- Requires explicit user input for all window names, open dates, destination (slide/screen/print), and language; does not invent or look up any missing calendar data.
- Implements a transparent workflow: plans and shows a labeled pack list before any paid generation, allowing users to review and confirm details.
- Uses bundled scripts/mcp_client.py for all remote operations, ensuring consistency and reliability.
- Enforces per-still billing, one call per calendar still, with real-time price checks and clear credit handling.
- Includes robust recovery, update, and review mechanics to ensure each generated still matches user-approved details.
